issues.description: The problem text instructs students to implement the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) as public for easier testing, but the UML earlier in the problem shows the method as private and both the template and the provided solution implement singFarmSongVerse as private. This contradiction (problem instruction vs UML and code) could confuse students about the required visibility and may cause tests that expect a public helper to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of singFarmSongVerse consistent across all artifacts. Either update the problem text to require a private helper (and remove the suggestion to make it public) or change the template and solution to declare singFarmSongVerse as public (public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)) so it matches the explicit instruction for testing.
